why_it_moved.text: Reformulation Rate rose +5.10% (+4.30% to +5.90%) alongside Queries per User, so users may be re-searching because first results miss.

would_change: A pre-registered primary of Successful Search Rate with its interval ruling out a loss would change the call.
Reformulation Rate staying flat in a rerun, or a split showing the extra queries are new searches not retries, would support Ship.
A confirmed pre-registration naming Queries per User as the primary, since the file lacks owner sign-off.

analyst_view.reason: Queries per User rose with reformulations, and Successful Search Rate, the config's primary, did not improve. The gain may be a worse experience.
